description: Studs, plate length and plate boards for a framed wall from its length, height, stud spacing, openings, corners and intersections. Source: Timberr Framing counting rules (field studs, king and jack studs, cripples, corners, intersections, plates); headers are not sized.

intersections.description: Places another wall meets this wall (2 studs each).

length_ft.description: Wall length, feet (or use length_m). Add length_in for extra inches. Unit: ft.

length_in.description: Extra inches added to length_ft. Unit: in.

length_m.description: Wall length in metres, instead of length_ft. Unit: m.

openings.description: Comma separated type:rough-opening-width-in-inches, for example door:36,window:48.

spacing_in.description: Stud spacing on centre. Unit: in.

name: wall_framing_calculator
title: Wall Framing Calculator
